changed.headline: Because of AI, surgeons at two Chengdu hospitals retrieved sperm in 68.1% of men with non-obstructive azoospermia, against 47.6% with conventional microdissection, and live birth per transfer was 38.5% against 26.8%.
Because of AI-watched cameras, more than half of the wildfires flagged by California's ALERTCalifornia network were detected before any 911 call.
Because of AI smoke-detection cameras, Arizona Public Service says it is notified of wildfires about 45 minutes faster on average than the first 911 call.
Because of AI call handling, Jeffcom 911 says it saw a sustained 33% reduction in administrative calls reaching its dispatchers.

Because of AI-generated teaching images, medical students in a forensic medicine course in India scored higher on clinical reasoning than classmates who used conventional forensic photographs, in a non-randomized comparison.

Because of AI, orthopedic surgery residents trained with a structured, faculty-supervised large-language-model framework scored higher on clinical reasoning in an unassisted final examination than residents taught the traditional way, in a randomized trial in Shanghai.

Because of an AI conversational avatar in virtual reality, adults with inflammatory bowel disease reported lower pain and anxiety right after a single cognitive-behavioral-therapy session, in a small two-centre pilot with no control group.

verifications.detail: window: drafter no grade, verifier pre.

The source supports higher retrieval and live birth rates associated with AI assistance in a retrospective cohort, without establishing causation. All quoted numbers appear, although its stated 11.5-point live birth increase is inconsistent with 38.5% minus 26.8%, which equals 11.7 points.

The article reports approximately 3,600 wildfire incidents flagged by an operational AI-enabled camera network, with more than half detected before public 911 calls. It supplies no dated observation period, isolated AI effect, or measured reduction in wildfire harm.

The article supports a utility meteorologist's statement that its AI-assisted camera system alerts it about 45 minutes before the first 911 call on average. It provides neither underlying comparative data nor dates for that average.
evidence: drafter A, verifier could not grade; attribution: drafter isolated, verifier bundled.
window: drafter pre, verifier could not grade.

The preprint supports faster initial action on real patient messages against concurrent matched controls, including all quoted numerical results. Message closure did not significantly improve, and the stated follow-up durations conflict with the explicit calendar dates.
evidence: drafter B, verifier could not grade; window: drafter no grade, verifier pre.
evidence: drafter D, verifier could not grade.
